definitions.explanation: The study of the Earth, including its structure, atmosphere, oceans, and geological processes.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}で{地学|ちがく}を{選択|せんたく}した。
examples.english: I chose earth science in high school.

examples.japanese: {地学|ちがく}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で{地震|じしん}について{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: I learned about earthquakes in earth science class.

examples.japanese: {地学|ちがく}は{地質学|ちしつがく}や{気象学|きしょうがく}を{含|ふく}む。
examples.english: Earth science includes geology and meteorology.

notes:
BRANCHES OF EARTH SCIENCE:
・{地質学|ちしつがく} (geology)
・{気象学|きしょうがく} (meteorology)
・{海洋学|かいようがく} (oceanography)
・{天文学|てんもんがく} (astronomy - sometimes included)

RELATED ACADEMIC SUBJECTS:
・{物理学|ぶつりがく} (physics)
・{化学|かがく} (chemistry)
・{生物学|せいぶつがく} (biology)

JAPANESE EDUCATION CONTEXT: In Japanese high schools, students typically choose between {物理|ぶつり}, {化学|かがく}, {生物|せいぶつ}, and {地学|ちがく} for their science subjects. {地学|ちがく} is less commonly chosen but covers important topics like earthquakes, volcanoes, and weather systems relevant to Japan.
